limitations: Classic BibTeX misc maps patents, standards, reports, theses, datasets and webpages to document. Exact source type and full identifying source note remain preserved; CSL is the richer typed representation.
RIS GEN represents standards/datasets. Patent identifiers are repeated in parsed source notes because Citation.js ignores M1 in its mixed parser.

CSL preserves all 18 independently checked fixture fields. Some BibTeX/RIS custom fields are carried in complete source notes rather than native fields, including applicant roles, project periods and date qualifiers.

unresolved.description: Exact formal slot strings remain independently recoverable. The unidentified witness remains a supporting unresolved object, not an invented bibliographic work or the URL of the 2013 work.
